related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign

outcome.implementation_change: Pressure context summaries now merge sparse and enriched records only when one compatible campaign/session/work-intent context exists; ambiguous or conflicting contexts remain separate. Authenticated session-activity pointers are validated as bounded record-captured references, their exact event IDs are exposed in full projections, and compact projections preserve up to eight IDs with an explicit truncation flag.
outcome.analysis_limit: Focused tests and an authenticated Compiler campaign projection verify the representation and provenance path. They do not establish agent uptake, reduction in investigation burden, or long-term recurrence or resolution of the related pressure.

improvement_relation.basis: This refinement continues the capability projection context pressure: after contexts were added, sparse and environment-enriched records for one work item could still be counted separately, and a captured authenticated event reference was omitted from compact output. Regression tests verify unique-context enrichment, ambiguous/conflicting-context separation, valid and malformed event pointers, and bounded compact event-ID retention. The authenticated live projection relates two real Compiler observations to one Compiler work context and two recorder sessions, retains the exact two event IDs, and links the source evidence.
